data.completion_memo: Completed SQLite/shared adapter acceptance after task 14. Added all-domain public-API conformance fixtures covering consistent snapshots, legacy schema-13 upgrade, write-free read-only reopening, two computer mappings, preserved IDs/links and receipts, mockup drafts/proposals, QA evidence retention, stale guards/readTokens, references, rollback and replay. Fixed a memory read that still initialized rows. Native Tauri/WebView2 plus an independent MCP process exposed and now verifies the fix for silent stale-editor overwrites: dirty text, Markdown and completion drafts pin their original resource version, survive refresh/rejection and require explicit current-value reload. Fixed Markdown effect placement and zero-size hidden diagram fitting. Final native verification ran through an isolated WebView integration harness without OS input takeover; all six scenarios pass and no test processes remain. Validation: 185 application tests passed (5 ignored), 10 standalone API tests passed, frontend/full native builds and MCP-only build passed, 39 MCP operation contracts with transactional/content-token checks passed, 45 reads preserved database bytes/mtime/revision, 80 concurrent reads preserved database/settings, two MCP processes passed disjoint/conflicting edits and exactly-once QA retry. Reproduction commands, intentional changes and native evidence are recorded in docs/storage-sqlite-validation.md; final native evidence is target/native-storage/037c59f2-94d3-4759-9ccb-414a0ed4304a/evidence.json. Text and server SQL backends remain intentionally unavailable pending their later tasks.

Execution order: step 05 of 13. Depends on Adashi task ID 14. Complete this prerequisite before starting.

Phase: SQLite completion gate before Git-friendly storage.

Build meaningful regression evidence for the shared adapter and SQLite implementation:
- Run conformance tests across every domain, including consistent reads, atomic multi-resource failure, stale expectedVersion/readToken rejection, idempotent retry and reference validation.
- Exercise separate desktop and MCP processes against the same fixture project, including concurrent disjoint writes and conflicting edits.
- Verify initialization and legacy schema upgrades separately from read-only access. Extend the existing read-only storage checks to confirm unchanged database bytes, mtime and revision after repeated reads.
- Verify shared project identity with two computer mappings, legacy IDs/links, mockup drafts/proposals, QA history, rules and memory retention.
- Exercise actual native desktop reads and edits plus MCP operations, including external-change refresh without losing unsaved UI state.

Acceptance: the SQLite phase has passing automated checks and recorded native desktop/MCP evidence. The backend selection remains per project, and the current SQLite workflow is preserved. Record any intentional API or data-model changes explicitly before the next phase.
